ex.s: 我開窗，你會唔會介意呀？

ex.r: m4 gaai3 ji3 nei5 co5 laa1
ex.en: I don't mind, have a seat.

ex.r: keoi5 hou2 gaai3 ji3 jan4 dei6 waa6 keoi5 fei4

fix.note: Colloquial Cantonese; often describes a skinny person.

ex.r: keoi5 hou2 ngan1 jiu3 sik6 do1 di1
ex.en: He's so skinny, he needs to eat more.
